title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid input data, set up a store, and be redirected to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Fill in valid user details and store setup information
Submit registration form
Verify registration success message is displayed
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to dashboard page

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that users can login successfully with correct username/email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Click login button
Verify user is authenticated and dashboard is displayed

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify that login fails with invalid username/email or password and appropriate error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter invalid username/email or password
Click login button
Verify login error message is displayed and no access to dashboard

title: Password Reset Request and Completion
description: Verify that users can request a password reset and successfully reset their password using the emailed link.

steps.description: Navigate to password reset page
Enter registered email for password reset
Submit password reset request
Verify password reset email is sent
Use received link to navigate to password reset form
Enter new valid password and submit
Verify password reset success confirmation
Login with new password
Verify login succeeds with new password

title: Multi-Tenancy Data Isolation
description: Verify that multiple tenants have separated data and cannot access each other's business data or settings.

steps.description: Login as Tenant A user
Create or view business data (products, employees, sales)
Logout Tenant A
Login as Tenant B user
Verify Tenant B cannot see Tenant A's data
Verify data access is restricted per tenant

title: Product Management CRUD Operations
description: Verify product catalog supports creating, reading, updating, and deleting products correctly and updates are reflected in sales pages.

steps.description: Navigate to products page
Add a new product with valid details
Verify new product appears in catalog
Update the product's details
Verify product details are updated
Delete the product
Verify product is removed from catalog and sales page

title: Employee Role Assignment and Permission Enforcement
description: Verify that employees can be assigned roles with permissions and the system enforces access control accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to employee management page
Create new employee and assign role with defined permissions
Verify employee appears with assigned role
Login as employee with restricted permissions
Verify employee cannot access unauthorized features
Login as employee with elevated permissions
Verify employee can access permitted features

title: Attendance Tracking Accuracy
description: Verify employees can log attendance and managers can view and edit attendance records accurately.

steps.description: Employee logs attendance for the current day
Verify attendance record is saved correctly
Manager views employee attendance records
Verify attendance records are displayed with correct data
Manager edits an attendance record
Verify changes are saved and reflected

title: Sales Transaction Processing and Receipt Printing
description: Verify sales transactions are processed correctly with cart calculation and printable receipts generated with accurate data.

steps.description: Navigate to sales page
Add multiple products to cart with valid quantities
Verify total sale amount and calculation are correct
Complete the sales transaction
Verify transaction is saved and receipt is generated
Print the receipt and verify printed content matches transaction details

title: Business Expense Logging and Reporting
description: Verify users can add, categorize, and retrieve business expenses with accurate reporting summaries.

steps.description: Navigate to expenses page
Add a new expense with category, amount, and date
Verify expense is saved and displayed in expense list
Generate expense report for specified date range
Verify report reflects all expenses with correct totals and categories

title: HPP Cost of Goods Management Calculations
description: Verify raw materials, recipes, and custom costs inputs correctly calculate HPP with expected breakdowns and totals.

steps.description: Navigate to HPP management page
Add raw materials with prices
Define recipes with raw materials and quantities
Input custom costs
Verify HPP breakdown and total is calculated accurately
Update recipe or materials
Verify corresponding HPP recalculation

title: Payment Gateway Integration with Duitku
description: Verify subscription and renewal payments can be processed through Duitku gateway with correct payment statuses reflected.

steps.description: Navigate to subscription page
Select subscription plan and proceed to payment
Complete payment through Duitku gateway
Verify payment success confirmation and subscription activated
Test subscription renewal before expiry
Verify renewal payment processes successfully and subscription status updates

title: Internationalization and Language Selection
description: Verify language selector dynamically updates UI language and all translations display correctly for supported languages.

steps.description: Locate and open language selector
Select each available language one by one
Verify UI texts update instantly to selected language
Verify no placeholder or untranslated strings are visible in the UI

title: Theme Toggle Dark/Light Mode
description: Verify that users can toggle between dark and light themes and the selected preference persists across sessions.

steps.description: Locate theme toggle control
Switch from light to dark mode
Verify UI changes to dark mode style
Reload the application
Verify dark mode preference is retained
Toggle back to light mode and verify same persistence

title: Protected Routes and Session Management
description: Verify that protected routes are accessible only to authenticated users and unauthorized users are redirected to login.

steps.description: Attempt to navigate to dashboard without authentication
Verify redirection to login page
Login with valid credentials
Navigate to multiple protected routes (sales, employees, reports)
Verify pages load successfully without errors
Logout and attempt to access protected route again
Verify user is redirected to login page

title: Landing and Legal Pages Accessibility
description: Verify the public landing page and legal pages (privacy policy, terms of service, about) are accessible and display correct content and links.

steps.description: Navigate to landing page
Verify hero section, call-to-action, and welcome message are visible
Navigate to privacy policy page
Verify privacy policy content and links are present
Navigate to terms of service page
Verify terms of service content and links are present
Navigate to about page
Verify about page content is correct

title: Developer Tools and Supabase Edge Functions Invocation
description: Verify developer utilities load successfully and Supabase Edge Functions can be invoked without errors.

steps.description: Navigate to developer tools page
Verify developer tool UI loads correctly
Invoke sample Supabase Edge Function
Verify function invocation returns expected result without errors
